tagline: We make a number for every game. We bet the ones where the market's wrong.

games.take: Thursday Night Football at Lambeau, and both teams arrive held together with tape. Carolina is without both starting tackles, both starting cornerbacks (Horn and Jackson on IR), top pass rusher Jaelan Phillips and corner Akayleb Evans. Green Bay ruled out center Sean Rhyan, guard Travis Glover and linebacker Zaire Franklin, with Matthew Golden questionable. Bryce Young was a full practice participant after his knee designation; Jordan Love is off the report. No true edge at the current prices — the best Packers price is essentially the fair — but the lean is Green Bay because Carolina's secondary and both tackle spots are gone on a short week.
games.title: Panthers @ Packers
games.verdict: LEAN: GB — no true edge, but the lean is Green Bay because Carolina is missing both starting tackles and both starting cornerbacks.

games.matchup: Florida Atlantic Owls @ North Texas Mean Green
games.take: The slate's shootout: a 78-point total at DATCU Stadium, with simulations projecting North Texas 48.7–33.8. FAU quarterback Caden Veltkamp is projected for a huge night through the air, but North Texas answers with Tayven Jackson plus a ground game (Jahiem White projected for 165.8 rushing yards) that keeps the Mean Green balanced. No true edge at the current prices — the best number on North Texas beats fair by only about 0.2% — but the lean is the Mean Green because the offense with two ways to score is the one laying the points at home.
games.title: FAU @ North Texas
games.verdict: LEAN: UNT — no true edge, but the lean is North Texas because the home offense can win through the air and on the ground.

games.take: A bounce-back spot for the Dukes at Bridgeforth after losing at App State as two-touchdown favorites. JMU's defense allows just 18.3 points per game and 110.1 rushing yards per game, and Troy's path — run the ball — runs straight into it; the Trojans score 22.9 per game and rank 124th in pass offense, so they can't throw their way out if the ground game stalls. No true edge at the current prices, but the lean is James Madison because Troy has nothing that bothers the one thing JMU does best.
games.title: Troy @ James Madison
games.verdict: LEAN: JMU — no true edge, but the lean is James Madison because Troy's run-first offense meets a defense giving up 110 rushing yards a game.

games.take: A coin-flip game in Atlanta. The Hawks are 2-2, scoring 121 a night behind Jalen Johnson (21.5 points, 9.8 rebounds, 8.5 assists), but Houston just beat them twice by getting physical; Cleveland's jumbo frontcourt of Mobley, Allen and Watson is built for exactly that. Atlanta is without Mouhamed Gueye (foot) and Henri Veesaar (season, ACL). No true edge — the best Hawks price beats fair by only about 0.4% — but the lean is Atlanta because the market prices this as a pick'em and the home side has the ball-movement edge (31.5 assists a game).
games.title: Cavaliers @ Hawks
games.verdict: LEAN: ATL — no true edge, but the lean is Atlanta because a coin-flip price undersells the home side's ball movement.

games.take: One of these 0-4 teams gets its first win tonight. Sacramento is the more depleted side: Keegan Murray (ankle), Maxime Raynaud (knee), Dylan Cardwell (calf) and Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery) are all out, leaving no defender to match up with Zion Williamson and no rim protection behind him. New Orleans is on the second night of a back-to-back and Jordan Poole is questionable (ankle), which is why this is a thin edge and not a big one. This is also a board play: BetRivers is hanging New Orleans at -215 against a 69.1% devigged Pinnacle fair, +1.2% EV.
games.title: Kings @ Pelicans
games.tv: Gulf Coast Sports / NBC Sports California
games.verdict: LEAN: NOP -215 — a real edge, not just a lean: BetRivers is hanging -215 against a 69.1% fair.

games.take: The battle of the unbeatens: Memphis 4-0 against Portland 3-0 at Moda Center. It's Ja Morant's first game against his former team since Memphis moved on in the offseason, and Portland is blending him with a returning Damian Lillard under first-year coach Micah Nori — 129.3 points a game at home on 51.1% shooting. Memphis has feasted on an easy schedule, but Portland's home offense is the sterner test. No true edge — the best Trail Blazers price beats fair by only about 0.6% — but the lean is Portland because the home scoring numbers are real and Memphis hasn't faced anything like this yet.
games.title: Grizzlies @ Trail Blazers
games.verdict: LEAN: POR — no true edge, but the lean is Portland because 129 points a game at home is the best number on the slate.
